checks.query: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name, state, labelsOrTypes, properties WHERE name = 'gsp_cost_lookup' RETURN name, state, labelsOrTypes, properties
MATCH (u:GspLow {id: 1})-[:GSP_LINK]->(m:GspMiddle {uid: 2})-[:GSP_LINK]->(v:GspHigh {uid: 3}) RETURN u.keep AS u_keep, m.keep AS m_keep, v.keep AS v_keep

bindings.predicate: all(x IN nodes(p) WHERE x.keep = true)

case.skeleton: MATCH p = $lowCostNode(u)-[:$R*$min..$max]-$highCostNode(v) WHERE all(x IN nodes(p) WHERE x.keep = true) RETURN u.uid, v.uid, length(p) AS hops
